title: IntentPackage
description: Front matter of an intent package (docs/design: HOTL — Intent Package Template). Intake assigns id before it validates a package against this schema. Checks that need HOTL's state (known people, connected repos, a due date in the future, a source link that resolves) are intake's, not the schema's.

id.description: Intent id assigned by intake, for example INT-0042; never set by hand.

title.description: Short name of the feature, under 80 characters.

po.description: Product owner: a known person with the PO role.

developer.description: Developer who runs it: a known person with the developer role; the default brief recipient.

repos.description: Target repos; each must be connected to HOTL and harvested.

autonomy.description: L1 agent proposes, human approves; L2 agent acts, human can veto; L3 agents merge to main once all gates pass.

due.description: Due date, YYYY-MM-DD; optional. Intake checks it is a real date in the future.

source.description: Link to the PO's original request; optional.
